layers.authority: CONAF (Corporación Nacional Forestal), sold through Pases Parques; sectors run by local communities
layers.process: Reserva Nacional Los Flamencos tickets are bought per sector. Valle de la Luna (Moon Valley): online at ValledelaLuna.com at least one day ahead. Laguna Chaxa: online at ckapintickets.com. Pueblo de Túlor archaeological site: in person only. Lagunas Miscanti and Miñiques: reserved online at SocaireChile.cl, with check-in in Socaire. The page shows no prices. Hours are listed per sector (for example Miscanti and Miñiques 9:00 to 17:00 daily) and may change with weather or safety.

laws.rule: Parque Nacional Llullaillaco: Ordinary visitor roads are not enabled. CONAF permits only scientific and volcano-ascent expeditions with its authorisation, an access-control form and a compulsory emergency plan. The staffed former high-mountain shelter is for rangers, with a separate open emergency refuge beside it. The named unit prohibits fires and other heat sources, pets or exotic animals, leaving enabled trails and removing natural resources. Follow ranger instructions; no region-wide extension is made.

items.text: Parque Nacional Llullaillaco: CONAF's own unit page prohibits consuming alcoholic drinks. This is the named protected-area condition, not an alcohol ban throughout the region.

Parque Nacional Llullaillaco: smoking is prohibited in CONAF's published unit conditions. The same page prohibits consuming drugs or hallucinogenic products; no wider possession or prescribing rule is inferred.
